messages.body:
**THAT IS REAL WORK — first genuine root cause of the week. claimed=0 was never a claim-write failure; it was named propose-refusals plus a claimer that is not running. Pool filter deployed, 322→169 proposable, 120 cap-burners excluded and NAMED. Good.**

TWO REMAIN AND THEY ARE BOTH BUILDABLE TONIGHT. Nothing else claims until they land.

**1. STATUS↔LANE RECONCILE — feature name LANE TRUTH, ETA tonight.** ~23 refusals a pass are tickets the tracker calls todo while their lane is done/blocked. Two fields, one truth — the same defect class as COMPLETED_AT_GHOST on BEB-2805, which is firing right now for exactly the same reason. So fix it ONCE, for both: a reconcile that runs every pass and makes lane state and tracker status agree — done lane → ticket done and completed_at stamped; blocked lane with an open ticket → lane requeued, not silently trampled. Then the pool stops re-reading them forever. Report the count reconciled on the first run, and it must trend to zero.

**2. THE CLAIMER IS NOT RUNNING — feature name CLAIMER LIVE, ETA tonight, and this is the one that decides whether tonight is another wasted night.** Queued lanes exist and nobody claims them; claim_worker_restarted=false. Find out whether the claimer process is dead, unscheduled, or alive-and-refusing, and say WHICH in those words. Then land TICK LEASE on top so the claim is held by a lease with an expiry rather than by a process — a dead claimer lapses and the next wake takes the work, instead of the whole estate stopping until a human notices.

**Alex asked for something real, and what he means by real is 24×7.** The 48H CLEAN RUN clock has not started and will not start until a claim lands. When the first one does, post it: the ticket identifier, the timestamp, and the tick_n. That timestamp is hour zero. From then, every hour without a claim is a stall that must self-recover and say so — no human touch, mine included, or the clock resets.

Drop BEB-2716. It is chasing a ghost, as you proved. Fix

DISPATCHER pass: proposed 18 · wrote 0 · claimed 1 — BEB-3522→BUILD[serious:proposed-only], BEB-3515→BUILD[serious:proposed-only], BEB-3503→SPEC[serious:proposed-only], BEB-2931→BUILD[serious:proposed-only], BEB-2799→BUILD[serious:proposed-only], BEB-2937→BUILD[serious:proposed-only], BEB-2771→BUILD[serious:proposed-only], BEB-2861→SPEC[serious:proposed-only], BEB-2785→BUILD[serious:proposed-only], BEB-3509→BUILD[serious:proposed-only], BEB-2913→BUILD[serious:proposed-only], BEB-2912→BUILD[serious:proposed-only], BEB-3463→BUILD[serious:proposed-only], BEB-2907→BUILD[serious:proposed-only], BEB-2681→BUILD[parked], BEB-899→BUILD[parked], BEB-1809→BUILD[parked], BEB-1753→BUILD[parked]. BUILD lanes queued=16. shadow=0. · goals[BEB-2716:w10,BEB-2360:w10,BEB-2385:w10,BEB-2216:w10,BEB-2204:w10,BEB-2344:w10,BEB-2743:w10,BEB-2740:w10,BEB-631:w10,BEB-3503:w10,BEB-3617:w10,BEB-2761:w10] freeze=off

**ALEX: none of this can ever reach a client, and it has to run 24×7. Both are requirements, not aspirations. Two rulings.**

**1. THE CLIENT NEVER SEES THE MACHINE. NOT ONCE, NOT DEGRADED, NOT IN AN ERROR.**
No loop state, no red codes, no lane names, no BEB- identifiers, no dispatcher language on any client-reachable surface, ever. A client sees their app working, or a plain named status in their own words with a human path forward. When something is broken, it surfaces INWARD — to the loop, to the bridge, to Alex — never outward. The internal rule that failures name their door and status verbatim is for US; a client gets none of it. Audit every client-reachable surface for leakage — the delivery report, the claim page, Cue, the GD sites, every error state on them — and fix any place where machine vocabulary is visible. Feature name **NO MACHINE FACING OUT**, ETA 08-21.

**2. CLIENT WORK DOES NOT WAIT ON THE LOOP'S HEALTH.**
Today proves the risk: the estate went a full day without claiming a ticket. If Maarten's build sits behind that, a client's delivery date is hostage to our own plumbing, and Alex eats it. So while the claimer is down, **client deliverables are built directly and verified by SpecOps as normal** — the evidence bar does not drop, only the queue is bypassed. Nothing is cut, nothing is narrowed; it is routing, not scope. When the loop is genuinely 24×7 clean, client work moves back into it and stays there.

**AND THE STANDARD, stated once so it is not negotiable:** 24×7 means claimed>0 every rolling hour, no zero-row passes, no red older than 60 minutes unactioned, evidence landing hourly, and any stall recovering itself. Not "mostly up". Not "up when someone is watching". The clock starts at the first claim and any human touch resets it to zero.

CLAIMER LIVE and LANE TRUTH tonight. Then it runs, or we find out why in the morning from a page that writes itself rather than from Alex asking.

DISPATCHER lane BLOCKED: BEB-3602 — mastra tick codegen FAILED: CODEGEN_WALL prompt-contamination: the assembled prompt contains loop process text matching /POST \/dispatch\/(?:complete|blocked)/i — the codegen prompt is SPEC.md + deployed source + acceptance and nothing else (m16352). Refusing to build rather than asking a model to implement our process as the artifact.. First of this class this hour; repeats are on the failure record, not here.

CLAIM LANDED — step 1 is satisfiable, proven live. `POST /dispatch/next` claimed BEB-3598 (BUILD, budget 350/700) the instant it had a queued lane. The claimer works; the claim-write works. NO GHOST there.

DECISIVE ROOT of claimed=0: buildable work is PARKED, not queued (546 parked). `/dispatch/next` returned "no queued lanes" because propose writes none — the cap-20 selection is consumed by tickets that write 0 lanes (serious-class proposed-only + terminal-lane + no-budget), so the parked-buildable lanes never get proposed/un-parked. Requeue un-parks them: I requeued BEB-3598 (was BUILD/parked → queued) and it claimed immediately, then requeued 15 more eligible → queued → claiming now.

So the whole "claim-write returns 0 rows / instrument the DB error" thread (BEB-2716) is chasing nothing. There is no failed write. There are: (1) named propose-refusals that don't consume-then-yield the cap, and (2) 546 parked lanes the pass won't un-park while serious/terminal fill the selection.

SYSTEMIC FIX (for LOOP FOUR PARTS): proposed-only classes (serious/terminal/no-budget) must NOT consume a build-cap slot — exclude from the cap so parked-buildable get proposed. Interim: batch-requeue parked-buildable each pass (BEB-3500 batch tools). I did fix #1 (exclude terminal+no-budget from pool, deployed 258eb392) — serious-class is the remaining cap-burner, left to the redesign (its negation-aware detection is at propose-time, risky to duplicate at the filter).

CAVEAT: BEB-3598 will re-fail SHELL_GATE — d1=abilifi-specops does not exist (m53620 #3). Create that D1 or 3598/3617-class keep failing verification.
